description: If distinct free names \(u,v\) are used for the body \(\theta\) and \(v\notin\operatorname{FV}(\theta)\), abstracting \(u\) and existentially quantifying is equivalent to capture-safe replacement of \(u\) by \(v\) followed by abstraction and existential quantification of \(v\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.fresh_ex_renaming.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'}
  [DecidableEq α] (φ : L.Formula α) (x y : α) (hne : x ≠ y)
  (hy : y ∉ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset φ) :
  ∅.Iff (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.bindVar φ x).ex
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.bindVar
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.renameVar φ x y) y).ex
